add_namespace = germany
add_namespace = poland
add_namespace = world
add_namespace = generic

# Three visible options, one with a tag trigger and effects worth reading.
country_event = {
	id = germany.75
	title = germany.75.t
	desc = germany.75.d
	picture = GFX_report_event_generic_read_write
	is_triggered_only = yes

	option = {
		name = germany.75.a
		add_political_power = 50
		add_stability = 0.05
		country_event = { id = germany.76 days = 3 }
		ai_chance = { base = 70 }
	}
	option = {
		name = germany.75.b
		trigger = { tag = GER }
		add_war_support = -0.1
		set_country_flag = refused_the_pact
	}
	option = {
		name = germany.75.c
		trigger = { tag = POL }
		add_stability = -0.05
	}
	option = {
		name = germany.75.e
		trigger = { has_war = yes }
		add_manpower = 5000
	}
}

# A title with a placeholder the game fills in.
country_event = {
	id = germany.76
	title = germany.76.t
	desc = germany.76.d
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		name = germany.76.a
		add_political_power = -25
	}
	option = {
		name = germany.76.b
		declare_war_on = { target = POL type = annex_everything }
	}
}

# Two events with the same title: only the text and options tell them apart.
country_event = {
	id = generic.1
	title = generic.shared.t
	desc = generic.1.d
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		name = generic.1.a
		add_political_power = 10
	}
}
country_event = {
	id = generic.2
	title = generic.shared.t
	desc = generic.2.d
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		name = generic.2.a
		add_political_power = -10
	}
	option = {
		name = generic.2.b
		add_stability = 0.02
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = poland.1
	title = poland.1.t
	desc = {
		text = poland.1.d_war
		trigger = { has_war = yes }
	}
	desc = {
		text = poland.1.d_peace
		trigger = { NOT = { has_war = yes } }
	}
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		name = poland.1.a
		army_experience = 10
	}
}

news_event = {
	id = world.1
	title = world.1.t
	desc = world.1.d
	major = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		name = world.1.a
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = germany.99
	hidden = yes
	title = germany.99.t
	option = {
		name = germany.99.a
	}
}
